content.comment_body: Hello, can anyone assist me? I can connect to the [product_name] via Web Server without issues. However, when using the [product_name] App ([version_no]) on my mobile device, I'm unsure what to enter under 'Add Tag'. For example, I want to add Flag M1, but I don't know what should go into the 'Address' and 'Format' fields for Flag M1. Thanks, [user_name]
If there isn't a manual for the app, try entering "[article_no]" as the address and "bit" as the format for flag 1.

For the Web Server: 1. Enable "Web Server" in every message text block you want visible. 2. Enable the Web Server and set a password (via Tools/Transfer/Remote Access; use 'Apply'). Once set, the selected message text should appear in the web server interface.
@[user_name], the user mentioned they do not have problems with the Web Server.

Thank you for your help, but the issue remains unresolved – see attached image. The manual for the app can be found at [url], but it's for an older version and the interface is entirely different from the current [version_no]. To [user_name], I want to clarify: I do NOT have any issues with the Web Server.
Sorry, I'm unfamiliar with the [product_name] App [version_no] and without a correct manual I can't provide help.
Have you managed to resolve the issue?
Hello [user_name], can you specify what your problem is? There is now a brief instruction for App [version_no]. See [url].

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience confusion when trying to configure the latest [product_name] App on mobile devices, mainly due to unclear requirements for address and format fields during tag setup. The main Web Server interface works well for users, but a lack of updated documentation for the current app version leads to uncertainty and difficulty in configuring desired features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking clear, updated instructions about how to input data into the [product_name] App, so they can monitor and control their systems as easily as they do with the Web Server.
